en: Oh... Sorry.
Nicely handled, Shinada-san.
Huh? Are you one of those Victory Road people?
There is no longer anyone in this town who can compete with you. You have earned a place in the Victory Road finals.
Indeed. It will take place at the Underground Coliseum, where all the strongest fighters end up.
Head there once all the finalists have been decided.
The Underground Coliseum? Where would I find that?
In one of the country's greatest pleasure quarters. Fate has a way of bringing the most powerful fighters there.
(That's not all that helpful...)
Congratulations, Shinada, but I haven't given up yet, either.
I intend to gain entry into the Victory Road finals no matter how long it takes.
Next time we meet, you won't get off so easily. My spear will be sharper and land harder.
Haha. You'll have to go easy on me, then.
That you, Suzuki-san?
Hey, Wada-san. How's everything?
Not good. I'm just sitting here twiddling my thumbs. Apparently nobody wants a ride today.
That's unfortunate.
Whoa! Was that a hit-and-run just now!? I didn't see it clearly, but...
Wait! Yuta! Bring back my Yuta!
What's wrong? Was anyone hurt!?
My boy... They carried off my little boy! He's in the car that just drove away!
You mean he was kidnapped? All right, I'll go after them! I'm taking your taxi, Wada-san!
You'd better come, too, ma'am!
Of course! Please, get my Yuta back safe!
Thanks for letting me borrow your taxi today, Wada-san.
Don't mention it! That was a fine thing you did, Suzuki-san.

I'm sure anyone would've done it, had they been in my
shoes. Anyway, I'll see you around.
Now there goes a hell of a guy.
You got 1,700 experience points.
Wada-san...
Oh, Suzuki-san! Did you get the kidnappers!?
No... I'm afraid I lost them.
Oh, that's not good... What's our next move?
Wait, that's my phone. Excuse me!
You're from the police? ...You did? ...Oh, that's such a relief! Really!?
Okay. I understand. I'll be right there! Thank you so much!
Yuta is fine. The police caught those horrible men!
That's good news. Shall I take you to the police station?
No, I'll be fine. The way you drive, it might take too long.
I understand...
Oh, I didn't mean to offend! Anyway, I'd best be going. Goodbye!
Well, at least nobody got hurt. Right, Suzuki-san?
Yeah, I suppose so.
(Um, no. I can't do this.)
Ah, Shinada-sama. I'm very sorry, sir, but you are not yet qualified to compete in the Underground Coliseum.
Participation in our tournaments is strictly limited to those who have won their local Victory Road preliminaries.

Let's see... Ah, I'm happy to say that you are eligible to join the
preliminaries in Kineicho.
We hope to see you advance from there.
(Victory Road preliminaries, huh? And they're going on in Kineicho...)
(I need to qualify for the tournament. So I'll just scoot on back to Kineicho and show those other hopefuls what's what.)
Ah, Akiyama-sama. I'm very sorry, sir, but you are not yet qualified to compete in the Underground Coliseum.

Let's see... Ah, I'm happy to say that you are eligible to join the
preliminaries in Sotenbori.
(All righty, the Victory Road preliminaries are in Sotenbori.)
(To qualify, I have to edge out the other Victory Road players in Sotenbori. Those poor saps... they don't know what's coming.)
Ah, Saejima-sama. I'm very sorry, sir, but you are not yet qualified to compete in the Underground Coliseum.

Let's see... Ah, I'm happy to say you are eligible to join the
preliminaries in Tsukimino.
But given your unique abilities, Saejima-sama, we could waive the prelim requirement.
For you, I imagine the preliminaries would just be a quick warm-up exercise. We look forward to seeing you in the tournament.
(Victory Road prelims are in Tsukimino.)
(Gotta win the prelims in Tsukimino if I wanna qualify fair n' square.)
Ah, Kiryu-sama. I'm very sorry, but you are not yet qualified to compete in the Underground Coliseum.

Let's see... Ah, I'm happy to say you are eligible to join the
preliminaries in Nagasugai.
But given your unique abilities, Kiryu-sama, we could waive the preliminaries requirement.
(Need to remember those Victory Road preliminaries are in Nagasugai.)
(To qualify fairly, I'll have to survive the other Victory Road fighters back in Nagasugai.)
We've been waiting for you, Kiryu-san.
The Victory Road finals will begin soon, and a new champion of the Underground Coliseum will be crowned.
The audience is beside themselves with excitement. I've never seen them so worked up!
Are you ready, Kiryu-san? We would like to begin.

In the finals, you will face tough opponents one after another. It will be single knockout style⑬if you lose, you're out for good! It is therefore recommended that you save before you enter the tournament.
Excellent, sir. Please wait a moment while we prepare on our end.
I see. Please let me know when you are ready.
It should be just a little more time before we start the Victory Road finals. Thank you for your patience.
If you would like to participate in regular Coliseum tournaments, I can help you with that.
Congratulations on winning the Victory Road Championship Tournament! We're very happy for you and your incredible accomplishment.
Please note that, pursuant to our rights, we will be publicizing this event to educate the public about the premium violence available at the Underground Coliseum.
You agreed to let us use your likeness for this purpose when you registered for the tournament. We hope for your continued patronage. Have a nice day!
Welcome to the Coliseum. How may I help you?
Please choose a weapon. Also, be aware that any weapons and/or protective gear you currently have will be ineffective.
We look forward to your next visit.
Sorry. The Underground Coliseum's not ready for action yet.
Come back later.
You're cleared. Go on in.
Hey, are you all right?
Ugh... I think I sprained my ankle. Can't move a muscle. Agh! Damn, that smarts...
You should get that looked at by a doctor. Is there a hospital you can go to?
Can't right now! I got customers waitin' for their oden! Gotta start work right away!
You shouldn't take injuries lightly at your age.
Look, I been runnin' the same damn stall in the same damn place for thirty goddamn years.
And I'll be damned if I let this ankle stop me now!
...You okay?
No, gosh dangit... The rush'll be startin' soon! Can't just sit here. Gotta start haulin' ass on this thing!
You won't be hauling anything like that.
Then maybe I can getcha to haul it over for me?
Come on! I'll make it worth your while! Just move my stall over to South Nagasugawa Street!
But how are you going to get there?
Simple! I'll just take a cab and wait for ya! Now then. Treat the ol' girl gently, okay? Bitter and old I may be, but lose that stall and I might as well lose my life!
I'm beggin' ya! Do an old man a favor!
Okay. All I have to do is move this thing to South Nagasugawa Street, right? That shouldn't be too hard.
Great! I owe ya one! But business is gonna get busy real fast. Ya gotta hurry!
Sure. Leave it to me.
Okay, thanks again! Remember, we're on a tight schedule here!
You come back to help me with my stall?
Sorry, you'll have to find someone else.
Oh, okay. I guess I can't force ya.
Hey, over here! Good work, man! I've got customers waitin'!
I hope I made it on time...
You did great! I never expected ya to show up so quick!
But did ya get the stall here in one piece?
Ah! She's in good shape, I see! Guess you treated her like a lady, huh?
Well, you did say you value it as much as your life, or something to that effect. So I didn't want to knock it around.
Thanks! You've got a good heart for such a young guy!
I was floored outta my gourd for a while there, but now I can get my customers the oden they've been cravin'!
It ain't a lot, but here's a little somethin' for luggin' my stall this whole way. Thanks!
You got <Color:8>20,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You got a pair of <Color:8>Hercules Gloves<Color:Default>.
I've been waitin' here for ages! How come it took ya so damn long!?
Oh, mercy! What the hell'd ya do to my baby!?
Something wrong?
The stall's a disaster inside! Which way'd ya come? I've never seen such a mess in my life!
Sorry... It's my first time pulling a street cart.
Ah well. I'll have it good as new again in no time. I'll have to ask the customers to wait a little while, though.
Hmm... It ain't a lot, but here's a little somethin' for luggin' my stall this whole way. Thanks!
The Vixen Zeroes are a team of gorgeous female racers. You have to win a race in order to see their face. Kinda intriguing, no?
You're actually pretty cute, you know. You could earn a killing at our place.
Oh, no thanks...
Babe, don't be scared. We're just trying to have a little conversation.
What he said. You're in good hands with us.
Sorry, but I have somewhere to be.
That's fine, it won't take long.
Yeah, it'll all be over in no time. Here, just step into the club for a bit.
I said I wasn't interested...
Hey, quit bothering her, you clowns.
Huh? What gives you the right to tell us what to do?
Can't you see you're making her uncomfortable? Just let her be on her way.
Aw, all we want is a moment of her time.
Fuck your moment of time. Sweetie, you can go now.
Oh, okay... Um, thank you!
God freakin' dammit, she's gone! Oh well. 'Least she got replaced with an even prettier package. We'll talk her up instead.
And boy does she have the goods. Mmph! And that fiery attitude... Just my type! Hey, hot stuff, you interested in makin' some serious cash?
Yeah, if you came to work at our club, you'd be rolling in dough in no time.
Yeah right. If the rest of your club operates like you two amateurs, I'd only be rolling in regret. So no thanks.
You nasty little bitch. I dare you to say that again!
Hah. This chick's so hot she thinks she can actually burn us. Hey, babe, if you want to make a good first impression, that's really not how you do it.
Who said I wanted to impress you? Next time you talk to a lady, try having more class than, "Hey, baby, I'm too dumb to treat you with respect. Wanna bang?"
This bimbo... I think we need to teach this biker babe wannabe some manners!
Hey, back off!
Seriously, cool it. You barkers aren't known for your restraint, but this is crossing the line.
Tch. And who are you supposed to be?

Just another person passing by. But if you think I'll keep
on walking while some goons harass a lady, you're mistaken.
I appreciate the gesture, but I'm fine. These pricks don't know what kind of lady they're dealing with.
Heh. Step right up, then. We're gonna pound you both into the ground!
I don't know what your deal is, but I can't let your attitude go unpunished. Let's do this.
Oh, Suzuki-san, it's you. Does this mean you're ready to take up the Spangled Meteor's challenge?
Yeah. I won't let the same thing happen this time.
Oh, is that so? Hehe. Our leader will be pleased to hear that.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I see. Well, let me know if you ever change your mind.
Suzuki-san... Does this mean you're ready to take up the Spangled Meteor's challenge?
Sure, tell her it's on.
Haha, excellent. I guess she picked the right opponent.
Well, I'd better be going. Looking forward to seeing you on the road, Suzuki-san.
(So I'm set to race the Spangled Meteor now... I wonder what she wants with me.)
Sorry, but I'll have to pass.
Mm. Sorry to hear that. Well, let me know if you ever change your mind.
That's a good girl... Hold still now...
Is that a... chicken? You trying to catch it?
Shh! This situation demands the utmost concentration! Don't talk to me right now!
Cluck, cluck, squawk!
(What the heck's a chicken doing in the middle of the city?)
Noooooooooooooo! Come baaaaaaaaaaaaack!
Hey, don't just stand there gawking! Help me catch my beautiful baby bird!
Wait, why me?

That chicken⑬a Cochin, actually⑬is a prized avian beast!
Its life is worth more than mine and yours put together!
Look, I'll even give you a reward for helping. Sound good?
You should've said that first.
Then go forth! Run like the wind and bring my Cochin to me!

Thanks, buddy! Wasn't easy, was it? This little fella's got
rocket fuel coursing through its veins!
Hoo... Haah... Yeah, that bird was bizarrely quick.
Dang it! Can't believe I got outrun by a chicken.
Hey, guess what? I caught my little cluckling at last!
